anchors.description: The declared callers implement their own copies of the same diagnostic severity authority rule rather than delegating to its shared owner. Similar unrelated logic is not a copy of this rule.
Some declared callers delegate diagnostic severity authority to its shared owner, while others implement a local copy of the same rule.
The declared callers delegate diagnostic severity authority to one shared implementation. This judgment concerns ownership of that rule, not proof that the rule or callers are behaviorally correct.

groups.description: Pulsar's two signal execution paths must share the severity ceiling rule. This one-group pilot is not an inventory of all domain rules in Pulsar.
